The test image shows a tomato leaf with a mottled pattern of light green and yellow areas mixed with darker green - no discrete spots, no necrotic tissue, no powdery coating. This looks like a mosaic pattern.

The affected part is **leaf**, narrowing to 11 candidate classes. The mosaic pattern of light/dark green strongly suggests Cucumber Mosaic Virus. Let me verify by viewing references across 8 classes.

CMV reference shows severe leaf distortion with curling and shoestring appearance. The test image has a broader leaf with less distortion but clear yellow-green mottling. Let me check other candidates.
Leaf Mold reference shows interveinal yellowing with patchy light areas - somewhat similar to the test image. Let me continue comparing.
Powdery Mildew shows distinct white powdery spots - not matching the test image. Let me check more.
Verticillium Wilt shows wilting/drooping leaves with V-shaped necrosis - very different from the test image. Let me continue.
TSWV shows bronzing with necrotic spots - doesn't match the test image's yellow-green mottling. Let me check more.
That's a microscopic image - not comparable. Let me check Early Blight and Septoria.
Early Blight shows distinct dark brown lesions with concentric rings - clearly different from the test image. One more view.

Septoria shows distinct small dark spots on a yellowing leaf - not matching the test image's diffuse mottling pattern.

| Leaf_Mold | Diffuse yellow-green patches on upper surface - closest visual match |

| Verticillium_Wilt | Wilting/drooping leaves - no match |
| Tomato_Spotted_Wilt_Virus | Bronzing + necrotic spots - no match |
| Late_Blight | Microscopic view (not comparable) |
| Early_Blight | Dark brown lesions with concentric rings - no match |
| Septoria_Leaf_Blotch | Discrete dark spots - no match |

The test image shows a broad, relatively flat tomato leaf with diffuse yellow-green mottling/chlorosis without discrete spots, necrotic tissue, or leaf distortion. The Leaf_Mold reference (CDDM_1006) was the closest visual match, showing similar patchy yellowish-green chlorosis on the upper leaf surface with "indistinct chlorosis" as described in the KB. While CMV also produces mosaic patterns, the reference showed severe leaf distortion/curling absent from the test image.
